understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete every level by placing each selectable piece on a goal tile marked '+'. When multiple goals existed, all of them had to be occupied simultaneously for the level to report WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces could be selected or moved using CLICK at grid coordinates, while directional MOVE actions were also available. Walls and obstacles blocked movement; clicking an inaccessible location caused no movement. Selecting different pieces required clicking their positions, and the step budget decreased after each action.
